verdict.rationale: The docs show a single SDK call, getSandbox(), that gets or creates a sandbox by ID. Each sandbox runs in its own isolated VM/container with a full Linux environment, and is immediately usable for exec, file, and code-interpreter calls. The community comments on boot time describe other teams' Firecracker setups, not Cloudflare's, so the 'in seconds' part of the story is unverified. Missing for 10: documented or measured cold-start/provisioning latency, independent hands-on corroboration of startup speed.
